recipes.name: Comforting Coconut Red Lentil Dal
instructions: Heat the oil in a sauté pan over medium-high heat. Cook the onion and garlic for 4 minutes.
Add the carrot and ginger, and cook for another 2 minutes.
Add all of the spices. Stir for 30 - 60 seconds to toast the spices.
Add the lentils and vegetable broth. Cover, and cook at a simmer for 15 minutes.
Meanwhile, add the rice, water, and cardamom to a medium pot. Simmer covered for 13 minutes until cooked. Then remove from the heat and cover with a lid until ready to serve.
Add the coconut milk and cook until heated through.
Serve the rice alongside the daal. Garnish as desired. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † If you did not soak the rice, you may need to add more water.
Storage Store the daal in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 4 days, or in the freezer for up to 2 months.
